🔥 open-news | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To programmatically discover, extract, and process news articles from the web, enabling applications like news aggregators, content analysis tools, and research platforms.
✨ Key Features: • Article Extraction (full text + metadata) • Live News Discovery (DuckDuckGo) • Google News Search (query modes, exclusions, domain lists) • Website Discovery (RSS auto-discovery, async crawler, JS crawler)
📖 Summary: open-news is a Python library designed for discovering, extracting, filtering, and summarizing news content from various online sources. It provides functionalities to fetch live news, search Google News, discover RSS feeds, crawl websites, and extract article text, offering both a Python API and a command-line interface.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ mimik | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating documentation, tutorials, and onboarding guides for browser-based tasks and workflows.
✨ Key Features: • Auto-capture of browser workflows (clicks, keystrokes, navigation) • Automatic generation of step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots • Smart blur for sensitive data (emails, SSNs, credit cards, etc.) • Manual blur picker for custom elements • AI-generated descriptions (optional)
📖 Summary: Mimik is a browser extension that automatically records user workflows, capturing clicks, keystrokes, and navigation to generate step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots. It prioritizes privacy with a local-first, no-account, no-tracking approach.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 NextSteamGame | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide game recommendations that explain the reasoning behind the similarity, focusing on intrinsic game characteristics rather than just player behavior.
✨ Key Features: • Semantic similarity-based recommendations • Hierarchy genre umbrella system • Vector similarity database • Metadata pipeline (Steam APIs, SteamSpy) • Review processing and quality scoring
📖 Summary: NextSteamGame is a Python project that builds a game recommendation engine based on semantic similarity and game identity rather than solely player overlap. It processes game metadata and reviews to extract detailed features, creating a richer understanding of why games are similar.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 proxelar | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Debugging and manipulating local HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket traffic for API development, application testing, and network analysis.
✨ Key Features: • Scriptable traffic manipulation with Lua • Interactive request interception and editing • HTTPS Man-in-the-Middle with local CA generation • Multiple interfaces: TUI, Web GUI, REST API, CLI • Support for HTTP/1, HTTP/2, and feature-gated HTTP/3
📖 Summary: Proxelar is a Rust-based MITM proxy designed for developers to inspect, intercept, rewrite, and replay HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket traffic locally. It offers multiple interfaces including a TUI, a web GUI, and a REST API, along with powerful Lua scripting capabilities for traffic manipulation.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ uncover | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated discovery of internet-exposed hosts using various search engine APIs for reconnaissance and security auditing.
✨ Key Features: • Query multiple search engines simultaneously • Support for Shodan, Censys, FOFA, Hunter, Quake, ZoomEye, Netlas, CriminalIP, PublicWWW, HunterHow, Google, Onyphe, Driftnet, DayDayMap, NerdyData • Multiple API key input support • Automatic API key randomization • stdin/stdout support for input and output
📖 Summary: Uncover is a Go-based command-line tool designed to efficiently discover exposed hosts on the internet by querying multiple search engines. It's built for automation, allowing seamless integration into existing security and reconnaissance pipelines.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 Lemuroid | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Emulating classic video game consoles on Android devices.
✨ Key Features: • Libretro integration • Wide system support (Atari, Nintendo, Sega, PlayStation, PSP, NDS, 3DS, Arcade) • Android TV support • Automatic save/restore game states • ROM scanning and indexing
📖 Summary: Lemuroid is an open-source Android emulator based on Libretro, designed for ease of use and a great user experience. It supports a wide range of classic gaming consoles and offers features like automatic state saving, ROM scanning, and customizable controls.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
